trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate, following the latest deployment.
2. **Rolled back**: Identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production, and rolled the service back to it in all regions. The rollback completed successfully — all regions are now running v2.3.0.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback action; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: Rolling back to v2.3.0 required no change-manager approval since that version had previously been healthy in production. You may want to investigate the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before attempting to redeploy it.
